g.text: Use-case scoring grid: multiply four scores, each 1 to 3
a 1 on any factor drags the product down; 81 is the top score
draft replies in a support tool 3 x 3 x 3 x 3 = 81
loan approval decisions 2 x 3 x 1 x 2 = 12
monthly tax filing 1 x 2 x 1 x 2 = 4
same draft replies, but error tolerance is 1:
a wrong answer costs a lot in loans,
so the error tolerance score stays low
first bets: high frequency, painful, error-tolerant tasks, with data
the scores are judgement calls: agree them with the team
